landing.eyebrow: A travel plan that feels like yours
landing.headline: Your first <accent>stamp</accent> is closer than you think.
landing.description: Pin the places you dream about, connect them into a route, and watch the budget and the plan take shape.
landing.feature1Body: Keep the cities, neighbourhoods and little discoveries you’re excited about in one trip.
landing.feature2Body: Plan around your trip’s own currency and keep estimates clear as the itinerary takes shape.
landing.feature3Body: Dates and plans stay together, ready for the journey ahead.
landing.footer: Your first stamp is closer than you think.
landing.heroCopy: Pick a dream destination. Globetrot turns it into a route, a realistic budget and a savings plan — and stamps your passport every time you get one step closer.
landing.mapAria: Interactive world map. Select the pins to build a route.
landing.mapHint: Tap a pin, then another, to string them together.
landing.mapConnected: {count, plural, one {# place on your route} other {# places on your route}}
landing.storyEyebrow: One board, from the first idea
landing.storyLead: Scroll through how one dream becomes a plan. It’s the same board the whole way — nothing thrown away, nothing retyped.
landing.storyNote: Onsen night in Hakone — book early.
landing.step1Body: Drop a pin on a country. That’s a dream — it can live on your shelf for years, no dates required.
landing.step2Body: Zoom in. Pin the cities, the market you saw in a film, the onsen a friend wouldn’t stop talking about.
landing.step3Body: Pull a thread from pin to pin. The order becomes a route; nights become an itinerary with real dates.
landing.step4Body: Attach places, costs and notes to each pin. Now the board knows what the trip costs — and when you can afford it.
landing.stampsLead: Every real step earns a stamp in your trip’s passport. Skip around as you like — nothing is ever locked.
landing.stage1Body: Keep a shelf of places you’d love to see. A pin is enough to start.
landing.stage2Body: Draw the route by threading pins. Reorder by pulling the thread, not by editing a table.
landing.stage3Body: Every pin carries its own costs. Estimates stay marked until you confirm or pay.
landing.stage4Body: Passport, insurance, a first night booked. Each real step earns an ink stamp.
landing.stage5Body: Your board becomes a travel notebook: today’s pin, tomorrow’s train, the address in Japanese.
landing.pipTitle: Meet Pip. Pip has <accent>opinions</accent> about ramen.
landing.pipBody: Describe the trip the way you’d tell a friend. Pip pencils a first draft straight onto your board — a list of changes you can keep, tweak or rub out. Nothing changes until you say so.
landing.pipPrompt: “I have {budget}, want to visit Japan for 10 days, love food and historical places, and have never traveled internationally.”
landing.pipChanges: PIP PENCILLED IN · TAP TO KEEP OR DROP
landing.visaNote: Visa and entry rules: always check the official site. Nothing is added to your trip without your approval.
landing.moneyBody: The board answers in a sentence first, and in a ledger only if you ask. Move the slider — that’s what you’d put aside each month.
landing.moneyAnswer: At {amount} per month, you could reach this trip budget by {month}.
landing.moneyExample: Example: a {total} trip, {saved} already saved, leaving 3 April 2027.
landing.trip1Body: Trains only. Port cellars, tiled stairways, a beach day at the end.
landing.trip2Body: A first time abroad, planned around food and very old wood.
landing.trip3Body: Buenos Aires, a ferry, Colonia and Montevideo. Eight days, one border.
landing.platformEyebrow: A BOARD THAT TRAVELS WITH YOU
landing.platformLead: On a laptop it’s a wide desk to spread out on. On your phone you pan the map under a crosshair and tap “Pin here” — no fiddly dragging. Everything you do on one is already on the other.
landing.platformDesktop: Desktop: map, route and the open stop side by side.
landing.platformPhone: Phone: crosshair pinning and a bottom sheet.
landing.finalPlaceholder: A place you’ve always wanted to see…
landing.finalNote: Free to start. Works the same on your phone.
landing.mapAttribution: Map data: Natural Earth · Map lines are illustrative.
landing.pricingLead: These plans are placeholders while we finish the beta. Nothing is charged and no card is asked for.
